template.name: Landflow heartbeat → Landfall
template.description: A dead man’s switch: Landflow pings a Landfall heartbeat every 5 minutes, so Landfall pages someone when the automation itself goes quiet.

credentials.name: Landfall heartbeat
credentials.description: Base URL, org slug and the heartbeat token Landfall gave you.

setup: In Landfall, add a heartbeat named `landflow` (or change **Ping Landfall**), with a grace period above 5 minutes.
Pick the **Landfall heartbeat** credential with that heartbeat’s token, and publish the workflow.
If Landflow stops (or its scheduler does), the pings stop and Landfall opens the incident.
